title: Patch: every menu fits one screen, desktop and phone, with a guard that keeps it so
pull:
**Pull request #1633 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# PR #1633: Patch: every menu fits one screen, desktop and phone, with a guard that keeps it so

Closes #1581

Every menu now fits one screen at 1280x720 and 390x844, and a new Cypress spec, `46`, fails when one doesn't. No type shrinks, and no engine, card or catalog code changed, so there is no patch fragment. The rule is ruling `R1581000`.

## What changed

- **The layout.** A menu's root takes `one-screen`, which makes the shell the window's height. Its one region, `one-screen__body`, scrolls inside itself, so Back, the gear and the title stay put. The classes are in `index.css`, with a compact tavern footer in `tavern.css`. Under 501 px tall the page scrolls as before.
- **The routes.** Login, account, leaderboard, practice, creator, together, patch notes, stats, series and replays got the classes. Account, leaderboard, practice, series and replays also got a wrapper, which re-indents their JSX. `git diff -w --stat` shows the real change.
- **The leaderboard region.** It has `tabIndex={0}`, since nothing in it is focusable and spec 38's axe would fail a scroller no keyboard can reach.
- **Deck builder and almanac on a phone.** They get the same region rule in `deckbuilder.css`, `workshop.css` and `almanac.css`, as they already had on a desktop.
- **The guard.** `e2e/cypress/e2e/46-menus-fit-one-screen.cy.ts` has 54 tests (27 menus × 2 sizes). Each asserts the page's `scrollHeight` is within `innerHeight × screens` and its `scrollWidth` within `innerWidth`. The tavern home, and the tavern home with the settings open, get two screens. The sizes are `viewports` in `e2e/support/config.ts`.
- **Where it runs.** `46` is in `SMOKE`, with weight 50, in `shard-specs.mjs`.
- **Docs and ruling.** `R1581000.md` and its paragraph in `spec/11-rulings.md`, with `spec/INDEX.md` regenerated. The e2e README, `BUILD.md` and the web README are updated.

## What I ran

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Spec 46 | 54 passing in 46 s |
| Other e2e specs 01, 06, 09, 10, 13, 14, 18, 19, 22, 23, 24, 27, 33, 34, 38, 39, 40, 42, 45 | all green; no `.scrollIntoView()` edit was needed |
| The 11 touched route and component vitest files | passing |
| Harness web-test command (`--changed origin/main`) | 52 files, 1420 tests passing |
| `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` | clean |
| `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck` | clean |
| `cargo fmt --check` | clean |
| `cargo jackioh spec index`, then `spec check` | ok (1087 rulings) |

I didn't run the Rust test suite, clippy or the other `cargo jackioh` checks (catalog, patches). No Rust changed.

Specs 22 and 40 first failed with `replayHash` unable to find `target/release/jackioh`. `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` points outside the worktree here, so the failure was environmental. I symlinked the binary into the gitignored `target/` and both passed.

## Decisions the plan didn't settle

- **`position: relative` on `.one-screen__body`.** This departs from the plan. On the phone the series screen first measured 929 px against 844. An absolutely positioned screen-reader-only `legend` in the picker, positioned against the shell, sat below the fold and made the page scroll. The desktop passed only because the content was shorter. The fix makes such elements scroll with the region. I rejected adding `overflow: clip` to the shell, because it would clip content silently instead of failing the guard.
- **`SCREEN` in the spec** holds only the ids it uses. The plan also listed `account` and `leaderboard`, which nothing reads.
- **The signed-out tests call `cy.signOut()` first.** `commands.ts` keeps the signed-in account for the rest of a spec, so the phone's signed-out tests would otherwise carry the desktop's session.
- **The series intercept body** carries `now`, `ranked` and `currentMatchId`, as `series.test.tsx`'s `view()` does.

## What a person must do

Add `46` to the smoke-list comment at `.github/workflows/ci.yml` line 22. The bot may not edit `.github/`. It is a comment only: the list CI actually runs is `SMOKE` in `shard-specs.mjs`, already updated.

## For the reviewer

- **Content that still scrolls inside its region.** The page no longer scrolls, but sign-up, the account, leaderboard, practice setup, series, patch notes, stats, Play together on a phone and the card pools still scroll inside their own region. Laying each out to fit whole is a redesign per screen, so I left it for follow-ups.
- **Settings dialog.** It is unchanged: its box stays inside the window and a tab's body scrolls inside it.
- **The practice lobby shell.** `Shell variant="lobby"` takes `one-screen` for every lobby screen, so the loading and failed screens take it too. Spec 13 passes.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 1 of 3.

Notes the reviewer left (not blocking):

- `e2e/cypress/e2e/46-menus-fit-one-screen.cy.ts:75`: The guard only checks that the document does not scroll; menus that are not card lists (account, leaderboard, practice setup, patch notes, stats, series, Play together on a phone) now scroll inside their own region, and no check would catch them growing.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml:22`: The comment in ci.yml and docs/v0.3.0/README.md:297 still list the smoke specs as 01, 06, 10, 13 and 19, so spec 46 is missing from both.
- `e2e/cypress/e2e/46-menus-fit-one-screen.cy.ts:334`: The series screen is measured only while a deck is being picked. The playing and result states and the series loading screen (view === null) are not measured.

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 5s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 0s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 2s |
| clippy (`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`) | pass | 129s |
| cargo tests (`cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire)"`) | pass | 1096s |
| web tests (`sh scripts/build-wasm.sh && pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main --exclude '**/src/audio/**' --exclude '**/src/fx/**' --exclude '**/src/cards/art/convention.test.ts'`) | pass | 111s |

</details>
```
